entities.name: Marriage as Christian Sacrament
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Council of Verona (1184) declared marriage a sacrament — indissoluble and under Church authority. Before this, marriage was largely a private/family matter. The Church required public banns, witnesses, and priestly blessing. The Fourth Lateran Council (1215) banned secret marriages.
